summary: Deployed a rootless Podman container (python3 http.server on port 8080) running under the unprivileged 'appsvc' user on node1, managed by a systemd --user unit enabled via linger (no active login session required). Verified boot-time persistence by rebooting node1 and confirming the service, container, and HTTP endpoint recovered automatically with a new boot id.
actions_performed: Installed podman on node1 via dnf
Created unprivileged user 'appsvc' with subuid/subgid ranges for rootless containers
Enabled systemd linger for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger) so user services run without an active login session
Created ~/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service running 'podman run -p 8080:8080 python:3-alpine python3 -m http.server 8080'
Enabled and started the user service as appsvc using its own XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (no login session)
Verified no login session/who entry exists for appsvc while service and container run
Captured pre-restart boot_id, uptime, service/container status, and HTTP 200 response
Rebooted node1 via a one-shot systemd-run reboot trigger so the exec call returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (f455a75c... -> e0bd15c4...) and uptime reset, proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-restart: linger=yes, no login session, webapp.service enabled+active, container running, HTTP 200 on port 8080

evidence.requirement: Container running as unprivileged appsvc user, serving port 8080
evidence.summary: systemctl --user status shows webapp.service active with podman container 'webapp' up, port 0.0.0.0:8080->8080/tcp; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session (linger)
evidence.summary: loginctl shows appsvc state=lingering with Linger=yes; 'who' shows no appsvc login session; webapp.service is enabled and active under XDG_RUNTIME_DIR without an interactive session

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/container health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f455a75c-ec12-49a8-a647-c2be3f67c08c, uptime since 08:26:21, webapp.service active, container up, HTTP 200
systemd-run scheduled a one-shot reboot unit; command returned successfully before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart actually occurred (down, then back with changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection reset) confirming reboot in progress, then reachable again with new boot_id e0bd15c4-e076-48fd-9512-62188e68a1b5 and new uptime 08:28:08, proving a real restart not just a service bounce

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: service auto-started without login session, container healthy, port 8080 serving
evidence.summary: After reboot: linger=yes, no appsvc login session, webapp.service enabled+active, podman container 'webapp' up with port 8080 mapped, curl returns HTTP 200
